description: SE423 final roadmap: how principles, organization, people, development approach, planning and control fit together, with the material to study for every topic, look-alike terms side by side and a coverage tracker.
lede: SE423 follows a project's life: the principles that guide every decision, the organization and people around the project, the development approach you choose, how you plan it (risk, estimation, scheduling), and how you keep it under control (quality, change). Your instructor marks the why and how, so each topic links to material that explains them.
